heroes.name: Doomfist
heroes.summary: The significant reduction in collateral range and radius on Empowered Punch diminishes his effectiveness as a multi-target disruptor.

changes.note: Empowered Punch collateral range gain reduced 75% to 40%.
Empowered Punch collateral radius gain reduced from 50% to 40%.

heroes.name: Junker Queen
heroes.summary: Increased availability of Commanding Shout is offset by reduced damage and a shorter utility window.

changes.note: Cooldown reduced from 12 to 10 seconds. (5v5)
Cooldown reduced from 15 to 13 seconds. (6v6)
Damage reduced to 20 (Down from 25).
Duration reduced to 1.5s (Down from 2s).

heroes.name: Mauga
heroes.summary: Better initial accuracy rewards disciplined fire, though his maximum sustained spread is now more punishing at range.

changes.note: Maximum spread while firing individual Chainguns increased from 1 to 1.5.
Number of shots until maximum spread increased from 0 to 30 shots.

heroes.name: Ramattra
heroes.summary: Higher Vortex lethality and more responsive blocking make Nemesis Form significantly more dangerous and durable.

changes.note: Explosion damage increased from 15 to 30.
Cooldown reduced from 1 to 0.5 seconds.

heroes.name: Sigma
heroes.summary: Reductions in shield health and overhealth conversion leave Sigma more vulnerable to focused aggression.

changes.note: Shield health reduced from 275 to 250.
Damage conversion reduced from 40% to 30%.

heroes.name: Cassidy
heroes.summary: The massive reduction in projectile size drastically raises his skill floor, making him far less consistent at mid-range.

changes.note: Projectile size reduced from 0.17 to 0.07.
Max Life Heal per bullet reloaded increased to 2.5% (Up from 2%).

heroes.name: Freja
heroes.summary: Buffs to fire rate and recovery speed provide a substantial boost to her overall DPS and mechanical fluidity.

changes.note: Fire Rate increased from 5 to 5.5.
Recovery reduced from 0.5 to 0.4.
Explosion delay reduced from 1 to 0.8 seconds.

heroes.name: Reaper
heroes.summary: Increased lifesteal and attack speed enhance his brawling potential, though his defensive window in Wraith Form is narrowed.

changes.note: Pickup radius of Soul Globes increased from 5 to 8 meters.
Lifesteal increased from 25% to 30%.
Attack Speed per stack increased to 5% (Up from 4%).
Wraith Form Duration reduced to 33% (Down from 50%).

heroes.name: Shion
heroes.summary: Faster execution recovery rewards precision, but the heavy nerf to Joyride impact damage reduces his burst mobility threat.

changes.note: Recovery time reduced from 0.4 to 0.3 seconds.
Impact damage while riding reduced from 60 to 30.

heroes.name: Sierra
heroes.summary: Increased drone health and shorter cooldowns ensure her utility is more persistent and harder for enemies to clear.

changes.note: Cooldown reduced from 12 to 11 seconds.
Duration reduced from 10 to 9 seconds.
Health increased from 80 to 125.

heroes.name: Vendetta
heroes.summary: The extended reach on Palatine Fang allows for safer melee engagements and more reliable cleanup kills.

changes.note: Overhead swing bonus range increased from 2.0 to 2.5 meters.

heroes.name: Venture
heroes.summary: Reduced recovery on Clobber increases their close-range lethality and improves the flow of their combo-heavy kit.

changes.note: Cooldown/Recovery reduced from 1.6 to 1.2 seconds.

heroes.name: Ana
heroes.summary: Enhanced Biotic Grenade values improve both her self-sustain and her ability to swing mid-fight health pools.

changes.note: Explosion damage and healing increased from 75 to 90.

heroes.name: Brigitte
heroes.summary: The addition of instant healing to Inspire provides vital burst protection at the cost of total sustained healing over time.

changes.note: Now grants 12 instant healing on trigger.
Healing over time reduced from 60 to 45.

heroes.name: Kiriko
heroes.summary: Trading raw healing for more effective clones and faster ability resets rewards players who prioritize accuracy and utility.

changes.note: Healing per projectile reduced from 13 to 12.
Clone effectiveness increased to 65% reduced (Up from 75% reduced).
Cooldown reduction per critical hit increased to 20% (Up from 15%).

heroes.name: Lúcio
heroes.summary: Increased projectile damage and better lifesteal on Soundwave significantly bolster his dueling and survivability.

changes.note: Damage per projectile increased from 20 to 22.
Damage increased to 100% (Up from 75%).
Heal increased to 40% of Soundwave Damage (Up from 33%).

heroes.name: Junkrat
heroes.summary: The massive damage bonus against airborne targets makes him a much more effective counter to flyers and mobile heroes.

changes.note: Increased damage to airborne targets increased to 25% (Up from 10%).

heroes.name: Mei
heroes.summary: A smaller projectile hitbox and reduced effectiveness against armor make her less reliable for frontline disruption.

changes.note: Removed increased hitbox size on Slowball projectile.
Damage converted to Armor reduced to 3% (Down from 5%).

heroes.name: Torbjörn
heroes.summary: Despite niche hammer healing buffs, the reductions in armor scaling and ability power noticeably hurt his overall combat efficiency.

changes.note: Added a VFX Trail for added clarity.
Heal increased to 100% of Hammer damage (Up from 75%).
Armor scaling reduced to 15% of your Max Life (Down from 20%).
Ability Power reduced to 10% (Down from 15%).

heroes.name: Juno
heroes.summary: Normalization of cooldown mechanics ensures more consistent scaling without directly altering her current power level.

changes.note: Reduced Cooldown now counts as base cooldown reduced instead of gaining cooldown reduction. Now scales multiplicatively with cooldown reduction instead of additively.

heroes.name: Mercy
heroes.summary: A reduction in maximum overhealth makes her more susceptible to being dove and burst down by coordinated enemies.

changes.note: Max Life Overhealth reduced to 25% (Down from 30%).

heroes.name: Wuyang
heroes.summary: Increased currency generation through performance allows for faster scaling and earlier reaching of power spikes.

changes.note: Currency from damage and healing increased by 8.33%.

heroes.name: Zenyatta
heroes.summary: Significant nerfs to his lifesteal and raw healing throughput make him a much more fragile and less supportive asset.

changes.note: Heal reduced to 30% of damage dealt (Down from 40%).
Healing reduced to 80% reduced (Down from 75% reduced).
